pages.title: Calling it
pages.text: Two ways: set the three $(l:event_horizon/ruins)Reactor Keys$() into the altar in the $(thing)Citadel$(), or use a $(item)Singularity Lure$() in the Tidal Depths (below y 150) and it rises out of the dark in front of you.

pages.title: Fighting it
pages.text: $(danger)Weapons pass straight through it.$() The only way to beat it is to feed it $(thing)unstable matter$() until it can't hold itself together. Throw items in: it pulls them to itself. Its bar shows how close it is to collapsing.$(br2)Anything else it swallows does nothing.

pages.title: What it eats
pages.text: How much each item counts (it needs $(num)2,500$()):$(li)Block of Neutronium: $(num)540$()$(li)Event Horizon Fragment: $(num)200$()$(li)Charged Crystal: $(num)80$()$(li)Neutronium Ingot: $(num)60$()$(li)Raw Neutronium: $(num)30$()$(li)Unstable Residue: $(num)25$()$(li)Hawking Mote: $(num)15$()$(li)Dark Matter Shard: $(num)10$()$(li)Mass Shard: $(num)8$()$(li)Void Dust: $(num)2$()

pages.title: Its attacks
pages.text: It pulls on everything, and $(danger)touching it burns$().$(li)$(thing)Rifts$(): red rings open where you stand, then snap shut. Move.$(li)$(thing)Tide$(): it pulls much harder for a few seconds.$(li)$(thing)Hawking burst$(): a flare gathers, then hits everyone it can see. Get behind a spire.$(li)It spawns $(thing)Spaghettifiers$().$(br2)Past half-fed it's unstable: faster and harder.
It drops a $(item)Singularity Heart$(), worth $(num)10,000$() mass (a whole stabilizer's ignition minimum in one item), plus Neutronium, Event Horizon Fragments and both Event Horizon Recordings.
